settings_tab_placeholder: Coming soon — this section is still being built.
settings_music_description: Browse your library, favorites, queue and playlists here.
settings_noise_description: Adjust master volume, mute and the sleep timer, pick a preset and apply it to the current mix. Import assets and manage presets in the Ambient Sound library.
settings_noise_muted_hint: When the sleep timer ends, playback pauses and the mute preference is kept.
settings_noise_preset_apply_hint: Applying a preset replaces the current tracks and does not start playback.
settings_noise_preset_missing: Applied, but {count} track(s) are missing. Map them in the Ambient Sound library.
settings_noise_preset_empty: No presets yet. Create or import one in the Ambient Sound library.
settings_media_connect_failed: Could not connect to the media service: {reason}
settings_language_description: Interface language, applied immediately. Follow system re-reads the OS language on every launch.
settings_about_description: An open-source sleep and focus desktop app.
settings_about_extensions: Extension model: wallpaper content and tool extensions are installed, enabled and removed in the Extensions tab. External scenes are discovered through content/catalog.json; tool windows are declared by widget manifests.
tray_tooltip: Lull (left click to show/hide settings, right click for the menu)
topbar_unlock_hint: Locked: dragging is disabled, click to unlock
topbar_close_hint: Close (hides to the tray; the app keeps running)
wallpaper_description: One wallpaper window per monitor. Turning a monitor off destroys its window to save memory and recreates it when you turn it back on; the master switch only hides and shows, windows stay mounted.
wallpaper_sync_span_hint: Forced in span mode (prevents seam tearing)
wallpaper_sync_independent_hint: Each monitor plays on its own
wallpaper_games_exclusive_hint: A game can be used on only one display; video and image wallpapers can repeat.
wallpaper_game_unavailable: The current wallpaper game is unavailable. Choose another option.
wallpaper_game_switch_description: {name} is running. Stop it, or keep it running in the background?
wallpaper_game_switch_hint: Stopping ends the instance and closes its controllers, including on other displays still showing it; background keeps it running at a lower tick rate.
wallpaper_params_hint: Parameters are pushed live from wallpaper settings to {target}
wallpaper_params_unsupported: This scene declares parameters but not wallpaper.params, so wallpaper settings will not push them.
wallpaper_status_not_running: Wallpaper window is not running (in dev, start with pnpm test-mode or LULL_WALLPAPER=1)
ext_signature_unsigned_hint: No .lull-signature.json inside the package; this is an unsigned third-party package.
ext_signature_blocked_hint: The publisher signature did not verify; install/load is blocked.
ext_signature_strict_hint: When enabled, unsigned or invalid extensions cannot be installed or enabled.
ext_description: Manage wallpaper content, tools, and games. Installing never runs them; permissions are granted when you enable one.
ext_drop_hint: Drop a .zip or an extension folder here; if dragging does not work, use Install from file.
ext_empty: No extensions installed yet. Install a .zip: a tool package has widget.json at its root, a wallpaper package has catalog.json, and a game package has game.json.
ext_empty_filter: No extensions installed in this category.
ext_dev_description: Mount a local widget project folder without copying files or freezing a digest; it still goes through the same permissions and sandbox.
ext_dev_add_hint: The folder must contain widget.json; after editing files, hit Reload on the card.
ext_update_notice: {current} is installed; confirming replaces it with {next}. Wallpapers reload the new version automatically.
ext_install_note_update: Confirming replaces the older package with the same id. Installing only writes files; extension code never runs.
ext_install_note: Installing only writes files; extension code never runs. Permissions are confirmed when you enable it.
ext_enable_description: Enabling grants the capabilities declared by the manifest but does not open the window.
ext_enable_manifest_changed: The manifest changed after it was enabled; confirming records a fresh permission snapshot from the current manifest.
ext_capabilities_note: Required items are enforced by the host; advisory items (audio/media) are not a security sandbox.
ext_capabilities_note_short: Required items are enforced by the host; advisory items are product policy, not a sandbox.
ext_network_hint: Without the network capability, CSP only allows the package's own origin.
ext_error_pick: Failed to pick an extension package: {reason}
ext_error_dev_mount: Failed to mount the dev package: {reason}
ext_drop_no_path: No dropped file path was received; please use Install from file.
ext_drop_unavailable: Drag and drop is unavailable; please use Install from file.
settings_theme_description: Theme glow palette, affects all Lull windows.
settings_theme_mode_description: Switch between light paper and dark ink surfaces, independent of the glow palette.
settings_window_description: Display policy shared by every Lull window; changes apply immediately
settings_window_taskbar: Show in the taskbar and allow minimizing
settings_window_taskbar_hint: When off, no window appears in the taskbar and the topbar hides the minimize button (the tray still opens them)
widget_player_description: A liquid vinyl player for your local music.
widget_pomodoro_description: A liquid hourglass that paces focus and rest.
widget_noise_description: Rain, wind, waves, campfire and distant thunder — five layers you can mix freely.
noise_preset_description: Save the current mix, import or export, rename and delete presets; map missing tracks here.
noise_track_empty: No tracks in this mix yet. Add assets from the Ambient Sound library.
noise_library_connect_failed: Could not connect to the Ambient Sound service: {reason}
slot_music_player_description: Choose which extension provides the music player UI; playback stays in the host media service.
slot_noise_controller_description: Choose which extension provides the Ambient Sound UI; the session stays in the host media service.
slot_section_description: Player and Ambient Sound are standard components; only one implementation runs at a time. Installing does not replace anything; switching keeps playback and Ambient Sound state in the host.
slot_switch_description: Only the selected implementation creates a window. Switching stops the current UI, not music playback or Ambient Sound.
slot_no_candidates: No implementation is available yet. Install or enable an extension first.
slot_empty_hint: This slot has no implementation. Enable and choose one in the extension center.
slot_playback_note: Switching the implementation does not stop playback or an Ambient Sound session in the host media service.
media_description: Replace media assets, including images, videos, etc. (more assets can be imported in the wallpaper asset library)
media_asset_missing: The file was moved or deleted. Choose it again.
media_not_running: The wallpaper runtime is not running; start it to configure media.
media_resync_hint: Restart the current asset from the same starting point on every display.
media_resync_done: Every display has been restarted from the same point.
media_manager_description: Import images and videos from disk. Files are registered in place: nothing is copied, transcoded or modified.
media_manager_empty_hint: Supports PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, BMP and MP4, M4V, WebM, MOV.
media_manager_missing_hint: {count} assets point to files that were moved or deleted; use "Remove missing" to drop them.
media_manager_preview_hint: Videos play only in the preview pane; no thumbnails are generated.
widget_library_description: Local music library management and editing tools.
widget_backdrop_description: Import, preview and manage the images and videos used as wallpaper.
widget_noise_library_description: Import Ambient Sound assets and manage categories, tags and presets.
library_folder_singles_hint: These tracks were imported individually and are not affected by folder scans.
library_folder_empty: No folders imported yet. Use Import folder or Import songs above to add music.
library_folder_select: Select a folder to view its tracks.
library_singles_import_skipped: No new tracks ({count} already in library).
library_folder_remove_confirm: Removing "{name}" only deletes library records and track references; files on disk are kept. Continue?
library_singles_remove_confirm: Deleting "{title}" only removes the library record and track references; files on disk are kept. Continue?
library_backup_hint: Backs up playlists, favorites, history, tags and smart playlists only — no audio or file paths.
library_empty: The library is empty. Import a music folder in My folders first.
library_filter_empty: No tracks match the current filters. Adjust the keyword or clear filters.
library_playlist_empty: This playlist has no tracks yet.
library_service_unavailable: Media service is not connected. Open this in the Lull desktop app.
games_description: Integrate with desktop environment, run autonomously, support low-frequency interaction.
games_empty_hint: Install a game package from the Extensions tab, then start it here.
games_auto_start_hint: Start the game automatically when a bound scene opens and no instance is running. Disable to start manually only.
games_resume_on_launch_hint: Try to restore games that were still running when Lull last exited. Off by default for safer crash recovery.
games_controller_follows: Open controller when the game starts
games_controller_follows_hint: Only applies to controllers with autoOpen=true; stopping the game closes all of its controller windows.
games_clear_data_confirm: Clear all state and progress for “{name}”? The game will stop, delete its save, and restart from initial values; controllers and wallpaper replicas will briefly disconnect. This cannot be undone.
games_delete_confirm: Delete the save for “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
games_wallpaper_hint: Renders the package's entry.replica directly; no scene needed.
games_wallpaper_no_replica: This game has no entry.replica and cannot be a wallpaper
game_wallpaper_missing: {name} has no entry.replica and can only be shown through a scene binding.
game_wallpaper_disabled: {name} is disabled; enable it in Settings to use it as a wallpaper.
